en: Job 8

p.src: 1  Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

en: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,
u.src: 1  Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

p.src: 2  “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

ja: あなたはいつまでこれらのことを
en: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?
u.src: 2  “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

p.src: 3  Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

en: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?
u.src: 3  Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

p.src: 4  If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

en: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.
u.src: 4  If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

p.src: 5  If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

en: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.
u.src: 5  If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

p.src: 6  If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

ja: もしあなたがきよくて
しいなら、 きっと今、
はあなたのために動き出し、 あなたの
えさせてくださるだろう。
en: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
u.src: 6  If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

p.src: 7  Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

ja: さくても、 あなたの終わりは非常に
en: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
u.src: 7  Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

p.src: 8  “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

en: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
u.src: 8  “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

p.src: 9  (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
u.src: 9  (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

p.src: 10  Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

en: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
u.src: 10  Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

p.src: 11  “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

ja: つだろうか。 葦は水なしに育つだろうか。
en: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?
u.src: 11  “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

p.src: 12  While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

ja: られなくても、 他のどの
en: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
u.src: 12  While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

p.src: 13  So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

ja: もそのようである。 神を敬わない
en: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,
u.src: 13  So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

p.src: 14  whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

ja: その確信は打ち砕かれ、 その
en: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.
u.src: 14  whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

p.src: 15  He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

ja: はそれにすがりつくが、それは
en: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
u.src: 15  He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

p.src: 16  He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

ja: 々としている。 その若
en: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.
u.src: 16  He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

p.src: 17  His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

en: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
u.src: 17  His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

p.src: 18  If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

ja: から滅ぼし去られるなら、 そこは
en: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’
u.src: 18  If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

p.src: 19  Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

en: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.
u.src: 19  Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

p.src: 20  “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

en: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.
u.src: 20  “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

p.src: 21  He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

en: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.
u.src: 21  He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

p.src: 22  Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

ja: の天幕はもはやなくなる。
en: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
u.src: 22  Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”
